premises: C1_SCOPE_COMPLETE: the declared context/task universe for the claim is soundly complete or a sound stronger superdomain is bound.

C2_ACCEPTANCE_COMPLETE: every load-bearing success/quality/hard-constraint dimension is represented by an independently verified Brain-owned acceptance relation; lossless raw-task preservation may prevent silent requirement deletion but does not itself prove semantic adequacy.
C3_BRAIN_ROUTE_OWNED: the candidate is produced by a Brain-owned route with exact content-addressed execution identity.

C4_TOP_OR_DOMINANCE: either the Brain candidate attains a proved objective top/floor on the complete acceptance relation, or every complete component is independently proved noninferior under an independently proved componentwise-monotone aggregate order.
C5_RESOURCE_AND_HARD_CONSTRAINTS: every load-bearing deadline/resource/safety/authority constraint for the claimed capability is satisfied.
C6_LIVE_REVERIFY: the final candidate is reverified against the authoritative complete acceptance relation after all trusted values/effects are resolved.
reason: C1+C2 fix the full claimed acceptance universe.
C3 binds the credited behavior to Brain-owned execution.
C4 gives an absolute ceiling/floor or complete componentwise noninferiority.
C5 prevents winning by weakening load-bearing constraints.
C6 prevents stale or proposal-only proof from being substituted for the actual final artifact/result.
Therefore every admissible target behavior under the same complete acceptance relation is weakly dominated or tied.
